email.subject: Blue Pipe Pros: mobile visitors can't call you
email.body:
Hi Ben,

I checked Blue Pipe Pros Plumbing's site. Two things are likely costing you calls: it's not set up for mobile, so it doesn't display properly on phones, and there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors have to copy your number and dial manually instead of tapping to call. Since most people search for a plumber on their phone during an emergency, that extra friction probably sends some of them straight to the next listing.

Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what I mean, no obligation.

Alex
Northlight Web
